answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can set influence equal to account age times honest epochs. A new identity starts near zero; its signal gains weight only after months of verified honest behavior, like rings in a cedar tree. An attacker spawning thousands of clones gets thousands of near-zero accounts, so the fraud never ripples outward. The attacker pays in time and locked capital: running thousands of agents honestly for months while risking slashing that resets accrued trust. One honest long-lived account beats any farm of fakes.
